_comment: Per-route payload ledger. Enforced by scripts/check-route-budget.mjs in the docs build (blocking in CI via docs-build). Fails when a route EXCEEDS its budget and when it drops far enough below that the budget has gone stale — see that script's header, and engineering/decisions/2026-08-17-studio-dynamic-loading-audit.md §9.7.
_units: bytes. eagerJsGz = gzip(level 6) of every /_astro/*.js referenced in the route's HTML. htmlRaw = the HTML document itself. Budgets carry ~3% headroom above the measured build; the gate also fails if a route drops more than 5% BELOW its budget, which means the number here is stale and must be ratcheted down.

studio._eagerJsGzNote: 659985 -> 654175 (2026-08-23): `architect-model.js` — the AI provider layer (OAuth, the model ladder, the streaming client, the catalog cache) — left the eager bundle. `WorkspaceSheet` statically imported it for ONE synchronous predicate, `orSupportsCache`, which now lives in its own dependency-free `ai/or-cache.js`; every other reach is already `architect.ts`'s dynamic import(), so the provider layer is now its own on-demand chunk (15.8KB raw / 6.1KB gz) instead of being inlined into the monolith. Measured -5.6KB gz / -16.0KB raw (640868 -> 635121 bytes gz), same machine, chunk count unchanged at 57. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See #1773 and engineering/decisions/2026-08-23-studio-shell-decomposition.md §5.2.
studio._htmlRawNote: 192800 -> 201600 (2026-09-06): the pre-paint shell gained the editor toolbar it had been missing. It drew ONE placeholder pill where the hydrated app draws eleven controls (Add slide, Reshape slide, Fix all issues, Version history, Slide settings, the Markdown/Compose segment, Collapse editor) plus the preview bar's step buttons and a real Reader-view trigger, so the whole band under the header filled in and GREW at hand-off. Those controls' inline lucide glyphs are the bytes. It spends more than the duplicate tail this same PR deleted gave back: measured 195679 on this tree, against 187218 with the tail deleted and the toolbar still missing — so this PR is net +8461 bytes on the route, not the -6182 the previous ratchet recorded. Both numbers are same-tree measurements from the docs build; the pre-PR figure was not re-measured here. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 199200 -> 192800 (2026-09-05): the pre-paint shell lost a whole duplicate header tail. It drew TWO of them — one for the desktop Read/Write "slim" header and one for Craft — because the app itself rendered two headers; the app renders one now, so the shell draws one, and the second tail's inline lucide glyphs (search, theme, mode, tours, Present, Share, feedback, menu) plus the Read-only deck-title twin left the document. Measured 187218 bytes on this tree. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 192900 -> 199200 (2026-09-01): auto-split enrolled `content`, `list-criteria` and `journey`, and the Studio inlines the component catalog, so their three new `capacity` blocks ship in this route's HTML. Measured exactly, by building this route twice off one tree: 192397 bytes with main's manifests, 193414 with these — +1017, all of it the three blocks, nothing else in the change reaching this route. Not given back, because giving it back means un-enrolling the components: `content` is the commonest slide in any deck and could not split at all. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-01-autosplit-splits-on-structure.md. PRIOR: 185400 -> 192900 (2026-08-19), the pre-paint shell's Craft activity rail filled with the app's own launchers (7.3KB of inline lucide glyphs); see 2026-08-09-studio-shell-structural-completeness.md.
